title: Hermite coefficients of finite sums
statement: For any dimension $n$, finite index set $s$, real coefficients $c_i$, multi-indices $a_i\in\mathbb N^n$, and multi-index $\beta\in\mathbb N^n$, the Hermite coefficient at $\beta$ of the function $x\mapsto\sum_{i\in s}c_i H_{a_i}(x)$ is $\sum_{i\in s} c_i$ when $a_i=\beta$ and $0$ otherwise; equivalently, it is $\sum_{i\in s}\mathbf{1}_{a_i=\beta}c_i$, where $H_\alpha$ denotes the multivariate Hermite function.
